name: Joash
bio: Joash (Jehoash), son of Ahaziah, was an infant when his grandmother Athaliah seized the throne and tried to wipe out the royal line; his aunt Jehosheba stole him away and hid him in the temple with his nurse for six years. In the seventh year, the priest Jehoiada organized the temple guard, crowned and anointed Joash king inside the temple, and had Athaliah killed when she tried to stop it. Joash began to reign at seven years old (2 Kings 11:1-21). His reign under Jehoiada's guidance is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
